summary: Autodesk filed an 8-K on August 3, 2026, disclosing completion of its acquisition of MaintainX Inc. The deal was executed pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated May 28, 2026, among Autodesk, its wholly-owned subsidiary Matterhorn Acquisition Corp., MaintainX, and Shareholder Representative Services LLC as securityholders' agent. Terms such as price per share, total value, premium, and advisors were not disclosed. The merger structure involved a Delaware subsidiary merging with MaintainX. This filing is a closing notice. What to watch: integration execution and any earnout or stock consideration mechanics, though no further details were provided.
